name: Icoon · 3D Blue download icon

title.zh: Icoon · 浏览立体外观图标并核对图片规

description.zh: 看具体蓝色下载箭头预览与图片规格。 Icoon是Solt Wagner署名的素材站，提供带立体外观的图标、插画与图片，官网将其标为AI生成。蓝色下载图标详情展示PNG、透明底与分辨率标注，本次未下载验包，制作源码、完整许可和商用范围仍未知。
description.en: Icoon, credited to Solt Wagner, presents assets labelled as AI-generated icons, illustrations and images. A blue download-icon detail page shows a rendered preview and PNG, transparency and resolution labels. These are image assets; editable 3D models, downloaded files, project source and complete commercial terms were not verified.

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Icoon (https://www.icoon.co/).
Technology stack: React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
Component specification: 看具体蓝色下载箭头预览与图片规格。

Visual details from source observation: 我们先看首页的素材定位，再下滚比较两排十张完整的光泽形状缩略图，不把局部画面当全库清点。蓝色下载图标详情有大预览，标注PNG、透明底和分辨率，解锁横幅与Mockup广告不作实例。此次未下载、改控件或下单，立体外观不等于可编辑模型。Pro有付费报价，完整许可与商用范围未知，不能把Freebies入口当作该素材的免费或商用授权。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
